name: mechanization
description: Inject the current datetime, standing principles, and this directory's recent prompts into every turn via a UserPromptSubmit hook

recent_messages.title: Recent prompts
recent_messages.description: How many of this directory's most recent human prompts to inject. 0 disables the piece.

clip_threshold.title: Clip threshold (chars)
clip_threshold.description: A prompt longer than this keeps its first and last half-threshold characters and elides the middle, so words typed before or after a large paste both survive.

inject_now.title: Inject datetime
inject_now.description: on injects the current local datetime, which the model has no other live source for.
